terrain_categories.name: Open Terrain
terrain_categories.description: Any area where nothing impedes a model. Models can be moved freely across Open terrain.

terrain_categories.name: Difficult Terrain
terrain_categories.description: Every 1" a model moves across terrain with this type counts as 2".

terrain_categories.name: Dangerous Terrain
terrain_categories.description: When activated in or moved into: take a Risky Success Roll. Failure = Injury Roll and Activation ends.

terrain_categories.name: Impassable Terrain
terrain_categories.description: Models cannot be moved onto or across this terrain. Exception: models with FLYING Keyword.

terrain_pieces.name: Landmark
terrain_pieces.description: A single piece of Impassable terrain (statues, shrines, altars). Can be used as scenario markers.

terrain_pieces.name: Hill
terrain_pieces.description: Open terrain for movement. Blocks LoS to far side if tall enough. Grants height advantage (+1 DICE to Ranged if 3"+ higher than target).
terrain_pieces.special: Height advantage: +1 DICE to Ranged Attacks if 3"+ above target. Blocks LoS to far side.

terrain_pieces.name: Linear Terrain
terrain_pieces.description: Walls, hedges. Open if up to 1" high; must Climb if over 1" high.
terrain_pieces.special: Defended Obstacle: -1 DICE to Melee if cover lies between attacker and target.

terrain_pieces.name: Trench Section
terrain_pieces.description: 4-12" long, 2-4" wide. Sides are Open if <3" high, must Climb/Jump Down if 3"+. Can jump across gap.

terrain_pieces.name: Ruined Building
terrain_pieces.description: Walls can be Climbed. Stairs/floors are Open; rubble piles are Difficult terrain.

terrain_pieces.name: Corner Ruin
terrain_pieces.description: Two ruined walls in L or T shape, up to 6" each. Can include upper floors. Rubble is Difficult.

terrain_pieces.name: River
terrain_pieces.description: Enters one edge, exits another. Dangerous terrain. Must include crossing points (bridges/fords = Open).
terrain_pieces.special: Only usable if scenario requires or both players agree.

terrain_pieces.name: Stream
terrain_pieces.description: Enters from edge, exits by different edge or ends in swamp/lake. Difficult terrain. Includes crossing points.

terrain_pieces.name: Barbed Wire
terrain_pieces.description: Area of Dangerous terrain. Common in No Man's Land and Trench Lines.

terrain_pieces.name: Crater / Rubble
terrain_pieces.description: Area of Difficult terrain. Shell craters, piles of rubble, fallen trees.

terrain_pieces.name: Minefield
terrain_pieces.description: Area of Dangerous terrain. Hidden explosive devices.

battlefield_archetypes.name: No Man's Land
battlefield_archetypes.description: The area between trench systems. Stark and deadly, criss-crossed with machine-gun fire and artillery. Only occasional ruins, craters, and shrines provide cover.
battlefield_archetypes.minimum_pieces: At least 2 of each type. Pieces >8" count as 2.
battlefield_archetypes.setup_rules: Each piece at least 3" from any other. Trenches only within Deployment Zones.

battlefield_archetypes.name: Decimated Ruins
battlefield_archetypes.description: Cities, towns and villages reduced to ruins by constant warfare. Brutal short-ranged engagements among shattered buildings.
battlefield_archetypes.minimum_pieces: At least 6 ruined buildings + 2 of each other type. Pieces >8" count as 2.
battlefield_archetypes.setup_rules: Set up ruins first. First ruin anywhere. Each subsequent ruin 3-9" from another ruin. Other terrain 3" from any other.

battlefield_archetypes.name: Trench Lines
battlefield_archetypes.description: Interconnected trench systems several miles thick. Deep enough to shield warriors. Combat mostly within trenches themselves.
battlefield_archetypes.minimum_pieces: Enough trenches to span battlefield edge to edge. Plus at least 2 of each other type.
battlefield_archetypes.setup_rules: Set up trenches first, connecting edge to opposite edge. Other terrain at least 1" from trenches and 3" from other terrain.

battlefield_archetypes.name: Mine Complex
battlefield_archetypes.description: Underground tunnels and surface infrastructure. Narrow passages, support beams, cave-in hazards, and minecart tracks. Close-quarters fighting with extreme cover.
battlefield_archetypes.minimum_pieces: At least 4 trench sections (representing tunnels) + 2 corner ruins. Trenches must connect.
battlefield_archetypes.setup_rules: Set up trench 'tunnels' first forming a network. Corner ruins represent shaft entrances. Other terrain fills dead-ends.

battlefield_archetypes.name: Urban Warfare
battlefield_archetypes.description: Street-to-street fighting in a partially intact city. Multi-story buildings, alleyways, barricades, and ambush points at every corner.
battlefield_archetypes.minimum_pieces: At least 8 ruined buildings forming city blocks. 4 linear terrain as barricades. Pieces >8" count as 2.
battlefield_archetypes.setup_rules: Buildings placed in rough grid. Streets (open ground) between them must be 3-4" wide. Barricades block some streets.

battlefield_archetypes.name: Forest Ambush
battlefield_archetypes.description: Dense woodland with limited lines of sight. Fallen logs, undergrowth, and streams impede movement. Ideal for close-range engagements and flanking.
battlefield_archetypes.minimum_pieces: At least 6 linear terrain (treelines/logs) + 2 streams or craters. All non-open terrain is Difficult.
battlefield_archetypes.setup_rules: Linear terrain scattered 2-4" apart. Entire battlefield counts as Difficult unless on a path (Open lane 2" wide, max 2 paths).

battlefield_archetypes.name: Marsh Crossing
battlefield_archetypes.description: Treacherous wetlands with limited solid ground. Boardwalks and causeways offer the only safe passage. Step wrong and the swamp swallows you.
battlefield_archetypes.minimum_pieces: At least 4 streams (representing marshland) + 2 linear (boardwalks). Hills are small islands.
battlefield_archetypes.setup_rules: Majority of battlefield is Dangerous (marsh). Linear terrain pieces are raised boardwalks (Open). Hills are solid ground islands.

battlefield_archetypes.name: Fortified Position
battlefield_archetypes.description: A defended stronghold with walls, towers, and killing grounds. The attacker must breach layered defenses while the defender holds chokepoints.
battlefield_archetypes.minimum_pieces: At least 4 linear (walls) + 2 ruined buildings (towers). Barbed wire and minefields in front.
battlefield_archetypes.setup_rules: Walls form a defensive perimeter on one side. Defender deploys behind walls. Open killing ground (12"+) in front of defenses.

battlefield_archetypes.name: River Crossing
battlefield_archetypes.description: A bridge or ford as the sole crossing point over an otherwise impassable river. Control the crossing or die trying.
battlefield_archetypes.minimum_pieces: 1 river spanning edge to edge. 1-2 bridges (linear placed across river = Open crossing). Hills on flanks.
battlefield_archetypes.setup_rules: River divides battlefield. Bridge is the only Open crossing (2-3" wide). Flanking positions on hills provide fire lanes.

battlefield_archetypes.name: Holy Ground
battlefield_archetypes.description: Sacred architecture — cathedral naves, crypt passages, reliquary chambers. Columns block shots, altar areas are defensible, crypts below hide ambushers.
battlefield_archetypes.minimum_pieces: 1 large central ruin (cathedral). 4 linear (columns/pews). Multiple landmarks (altars/statues).
battlefield_archetypes.setup_rules: Central cathedral building dominates. Columns provide Cover lanes. Altar (landmark) at center is objective. Crypts (trenches) optional below.

battlefield_archetypes.name: Industrial Ruin
battlefield_archetypes.description: Bombed-out factory with machinery, catwalks, pipes, and fuel tanks. Dangerous terrain from leaked chemicals. Multi-level with elevation advantages.
battlefield_archetypes.minimum_pieces: At least 4 ruined buildings (factory blocks). 2 hills (catwalks/platforms). Craters filled with chemicals (Dangerous).
battlefield_archetypes.setup_rules: Factory blocks placed 4-6" apart. Catwalks (hills) connect upper levels. Chemical craters (Dangerous) scattered between buildings.

battlefield_archetypes.name: Open Field
battlefield_archetypes.description: Wide-open terrain with minimal cover. Artillery dominates. Speed and firepower determine survival — there is nowhere to hide.
battlefield_archetypes.minimum_pieces: Maximum 4 terrain pieces total. Mostly open. 1-2 hills, 1-2 craters for minimal cover.
battlefield_archetypes.setup_rules: Sparse terrain only. No piece within 6" of another. Vast open killing ground between deployment zones.

battlefield_archetypes.name: Hellscape
battlefield_archetypes.description: Reality fractured by Infernal energy. Lava fissures, floating debris, inverted gravity pockets, and demonic terrain that shifts between turns.
battlefield_archetypes.minimum_pieces: At least 2 rivers (lava fissures, Dangerous). 4 craters. Multiple landmarks (daemon totems).
battlefield_archetypes.setup_rules: Lava fissures (rivers, Dangerous not crossable except at bridges). Craters glow with infernal energy. D6 each turn: on 1, random terrain piece moves D6" in random direction.

terrain_battlefields.description: Maps strategic map terrain types to which battlefield archetypes are used when fighting at that location.

cover.ranged_penalty: -1 DICE to Ranged Attack rolls if target is in Cover
cover.melee_penalty: -1 DICE (Defended Obstacle) if cover lies between attacker and target

elevation.ranged_bonus: +1 DICE to Ranged Attack if attacker is 3"+ higher than target

climbing.risky_roll: Risky Success Roll required to Climb sheer surfaces. Failure = Activation ends.
climbing.jumping_gap: Can jump gaps up to half Movement Characteristic. Risky Success Roll. Failure = Fall.
climbing.jumping_down: Free (no movement cost). Falls 3"+ = Injury Roll (+1 INJURY DICE per 3").
